backend_matrix.reason: A bounded steady one-way Ohmic solved-current midpoint reference slice remains available. The closure-aware RT0/OE-F1/OE-F2 CPU/double path selects fem_stage_oersted_callback.v1 for public closed_geometry and complete external_lead views. Reciprocal M2 selects fem_stage_transport_callback.v1 for torque alone or fem_stage_transport_oersted_callback.v1 when torque and descriptor-free H1/P1 solved-current Oersted share one exact-stage solve. The external-lead path has managed three-step native CPU Heun, RK4, RK23 and RK45 trajectories plus adaptive RK23 rejection/rollback/retry proof; ABM3 is unsupported by native FEM and fails closed, while public Python-fixture execution, reciprocal external-lead, tabulated-artifact resolution, GPU and production qualification remain open.
No device-resident solved-current Oersted realization is qualified; FEM transport/Oersted requests fail closed instead of falling back.

The normative fdm_oersted_cell_integrated_open.v1 contract has a native CPU/FP64 owner, independent long-double surface-potential oracle, adaptive surface spot checks and an append-only C ABI/Rust FFI boundary. Public NativeM1 consumes accepted raw face current but remains fail-closed because public FDM ProblemIR has no complete closure/source-cut descriptor; named continuum workloads and production qualification remain absent, so the lane stays semantic_only.
No cross-backend solved-current dynamic-Oersted qualification is asserted by this page.
